item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 09/Sep/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An upper-air disturbance will bring showers and thunderstorms to the coast of Guangdong today. With the upper-air disturbance departing and under the influence of a continental airstream, the weather will be bright over southern China midweek this week. High temperatures will also trigger showers. A broad trough of low pressure will bring unsettled weather to the central and northern parts of the South China Sea in the latter part of this week. Besides, a broad area of low pressure will affect the seas east of Taiwan in the next couple of days.
